Scythe.purpose: Break positions through mobile melee pressure.

a1.name: Feral Claws
a1.mechanic: Baseline melee hits permanently destroy 1 enemy armour point.
a1.rule: Bonus affects armour pool, not free HP damage.

a2.name: Regrowth
a2.mechanic: At the start of your phase, restore 1 HP.
a2.rule: Cannot heal above the 50% post-downing ceiling.

a4.name: Plate Ripper
a4.mechanic: Claw strikes destroy 1 additional armour point.
a4.rule: Select this OR Fast Knit at level 4.

a4.name: Fast Knit
a4.mechanic: If you ended last turn with 1+ unused AP, Regrowth restores +1 HP.
a4.rule: Healing still obeys injury and downing limits.

a6.name: Savage Counter
a6.mechanic: Heavy melee hit; until next phase, counter the first adjacent melee attacker.
a6.rule: Counterattack once; no counter if incapacitated.

a8.name: Rabid Frenzy
a8.mechanic: Strike the same adjacent enemy twice; each hit applies claw armour destruction.
a8.rule: High single-target burst; full 3 AP commitment.

origins.name: SCORPION
origins.risk: Poison-resistant robots, heavy armour and ranged kiting

a1.name: Chitinous Stinger
a1.mechanic: Gain +1 intact personal armour; first melee hit each round applies poison (1 HP over 2 phases).
a1.rule: Poison is chemical; robots resist it. Switching armour cap cannot repair breakage.

a2.name: Hook Sting
a2.mechanic: Short-range sting: apply poison and root one movable target for 1 phase.
a2.rule: Target can still attack; large bosses resist immobilisation.

a4.name: Barbed Impaler
a4.mechanic: Drag a light foe 1 tile toward you, then make a melee strike.
a4.rule: Legal path required; heavy anchored targets resist pull.

a4.name: Chitin Dodge
a4.mechanic: Next targeted single-target attack against you misses.
a4.rule: Area damage and environmental hazards still hit.

a6.name: Carapace Rush
a6.mechanic: Advance up to 2 clear tiles; gain 1 temporary barrier until next phase.
a6.rule: Barriers do not repair destroyed armour or bypass enemy overwatch.

a8.name: Deathsting
a8.mechanic: Lunge and sting twice; if target is already poisoned, second hit deals +1 damage and MOVE -2 next phase.
a8.rule: Single-target finisher; weak into chemical-resistant enemies.

1.name: Charge
1.mechanic: Advance up to 2 tiles directly toward a foe and make one melee hit.
1.rule: Requires a traversable approach; no free teleport.

3.name: Threatening Presence
3.mechanic: Make one melee opportunity attack when an adjacent foe walks away.
3.rule: No trigger from shoves, leaps or teleports.

5.name: Pursuit
5.mechanic: After a close-range kill, step up to 2 clear tiles.
5.rule: No extra action or attack granted.

5.name: Execution Drill
5.mechanic: Deal +1 damage to a target with no allied enemies adjacent to it.
5.rule: Requires isolating the target; not a blanket damage buff.

7.name: Opening Blow
7.mechanic: Your first close-range hit primes the next allied close-range hit for +1 damage.
7.rule: Does not generate a free allied attack.

9.name: Overdrive
9.mechanic: For this turn, gain +2 movement and +1 close-range hit damage.
9.rule: Short burst only; once per room.

assessment: WOLVERINE: persistent armour shred and regeneration; loses to ranged kiting
SCORPION: chitin durability plus venom/control; poison-resistant foes counter it
TEST: armour regeneration + venom over 3–4 linked rooms; avoid idle-turn farming.
Scythe.revision: Arachnid removed. Scorpion adds intact carapace armour and venom control; no teleport abilities.

Anvil.purpose: Absorb punishment and decisively win contested melee.

origins.name: STEEL SKIN
origins.risk: Electrical damage, armour bypass and kiting

a1.name: Ferrous Body
a1.mechanic: In metal form gain +2 maximum intact personal armour; lose 1 move tile.
a1.rule: Destroyed armour capacity stays broken until mission end.

a2.name: Hammerfist
a2.mechanic: Heavy melee blow deals +1 damage and destroys 1 armour point.
a2.rule: Also damages one low-cover tile adjacent to target.

a4.name: Iron Lock
a4.mechanic: Brace until next phase: cannot be pushed by ordinary foes; counter first melee approach.
a4.rule: Cannot voluntarily move while braced.

a4.name: Wallbreaker
a4.mechanic: Break one low-cover tile, then strike one enemy immediately behind it.
a4.rule: No attack if no legal target behind cover.

a6.name: Quake Slam
a6.mechanic: Hit enemies on adjacent tiles and crack low cover; light enemies stagger.
a6.rule: Large bosses take damage but cannot be displaced.

a8.name: Iron Cataclysm
a8.mechanic: Devastating adjacent-area smash with permanent armour destruction.
a8.rule: Suffer electrical vulnerability through your next phase.

origins.name: PSIONIC ARMOUR
origins.risk: Shield depletion and attacks from several angles

a1.name: Force Shell
a1.mechanic: Gain a temporary 2-point psionic barrier until your next phase.
a1.rule: Separate from armour: does not auto-regenerate.

a2.name: Force Ram
a2.mechanic: Hit an adjacent enemy for +1 damage and shove it 1 tile.
a2.rule: Spend 1 active shield point to shove 1 extra tile.

a4.name: Aegis Relay
a4.mechanic: Transfer your remaining active Force Shell to an ally within 3 tiles.
a4.rule: Your own shield ends; ally gains no repaired armour.

a4.name: Psychic Burst
a4.mechanic: Consume Force Shell to damage and shove nearby movable enemies.
a4.rule: Without shield, the burst is weaker.

a6.name: Projected Strike
a6.mechanic: Attack one target along a clear straight line using projected force.

a8.name: Shell Collapse
a8.mechanic: Detonate your active barrier in a short cone; damage scales with remaining shield.
a8.rule: Shield vanishes; limited damage if cast unshielded.

1.name: Breakthrough
1.mechanic: Advance up to 2 tiles toward a foe and deliver a heavy melee hit.
1.rule: Cannot cross blocked tiles or strike through solid cover.

3.name: Hard to Shift
3.mechanic: Ignore one forced displacement; your next melee attack gains +1 damage.
3.rule: Does not resist normal incoming damage.

5.name: Bloodied Charge
5.mechanic: After taking HP damage, next melee hit destroys 1 extra armour point.
5.rule: Must suffer real HP damage, not just shield loss.

5.name: Unyielding Route
5.mechanic: After a melee kill, step 1 tile and resist your next shove.
5.rule: Helps position rather than increasing raw damage.

7.name: Pressure Breaker
7.mechanic: Your first melee hit on a covered foe exposes its cover side to the next allied strike.
7.rule: Does not permanently destroy the cover tile.

9.name: Siege Momentum
9.mechanic: Step up to 2 tiles; your next melee attack ignores one cover side.
9.rule: One turn only; no additional attack created.

assessment: TEST: verify intact armour cap does not restore mission-broken armour.
Anvil.revision: Size Shifting removed. Mechanical Juggernaut removed from Iskra separately.

Glaz.purpose: Make enemies waste actions and misjudge the battlefield.

origins.name: TELEPATHY
origins.risk: Robots, fearless bosses and blocked sightlines

a1.name: Intrusive Thought
a1.mechanic: A visible organic foe deals 1 less damage on its next attack this phase.
a1.rule: Robots are immune; major bosses may reduce penalty.

a2.name: Panic Spike
a2.mechanic: An organic foe cannot advance toward the squad and loses reactions for 1 phase.
a2.rule: It may still attack or retreat; bosses resist fear.

a4.name: Borrow Sight
a4.mechanic: Read one organic mind: reveal target state and give next allied attack +1 range.
a4.rule: No automatic hit or damage bonus.

a4.name: Compel Step
a4.mechanic: Force a susceptible organic foe to walk up to 2 tiles along a legal path.
a4.rule: Cannot force suicidal movement; bosses can resist.

a6.name: Mind Lock
a6.mechanic: Prevent one organic enemy using non-basic abilities or reactions for 1 phase.
a6.rule: Basic movement and one standard attack stay available.

a8.name: Mass Panic
a8.mechanic: In a small area, organic enemies lose reactions and 2 movement next phase.
a8.rule: Fearless bosses have reduced effect; no skipped turns.

origins.name: TELEKINESIS
origins.risk: Heavy anchors, boss resistance and open maps with little cover

a1.name: Force Hand
a1.mechanic: Push or pull a visible movable enemy 1 tile.
a1.rule: If forced out of cover, next allied hit ignores that cover; no raw damage.

a2.name: Kinetic Drag
a2.mechanic: Drag one enemy up to 2 tiles along a legal route.
a2.rule: Cannot drag through solid walls, allies or impassable hazards.

a4.name: Kinetic Slam
a4.mechanic: Throw a movable foe against nearby light cover: deal 1 damage, +1 on collision.
a4.rule: Cracks fragile cover; large or anchored targets resist the displacement.

a4.name: Lift Ally
a4.mechanic: Reposition one ally up to 2 tiles across engagement or low cover.
a4.rule: Destination must be legal; grants no extra AP.

a6.name: Vector Pull
a6.mechanic: Pull up to 2 light enemies 1 tile each toward a visible chosen tile.
a6.rule: Cannot move bosses or force enemies into impassable cells.

a8.name: Gravity Well
a8.mechanic: For 1 phase, entering enemies pull 1 tile toward centre and lose 2 move.
a8.rule: One collision may deal 1 kinetic damage; heavy bosses resist pull.

1.name: Disrupt Focus
1.mechanic: Remove one enemy's overwatch and melee reactions until its next phase.
1.rule: Enemy retains normal movement and attacks.

3.name: Create Opening
3.mechanic: Next allied hit on one foe you disrupted ignores directional cover.
3.rule: Attacker still needs a legal firing line or melee position.

5.name: Deny Response
5.mechanic: A foe affected by your control cannot enter overwatch this phase.
5.rule: Enemy immunity to the control effect also blocks this.

5.name: Expose Weakness
5.mechanic: First allied hit on a foe you disrupted destroys 1 extra armour point.

7.name: Safe Passage
7.mechanic: One ally may cross a threatened tile beside a disrupted enemy without its reaction.
7.rule: Other enemies can still use overwatch normally.

9.name: Master Interference
9.mechanic: Create a small zone for 1 phase: first hostile move is shortened and reactions fail.
9.rule: Bosses lose reactions only; cannot skip full turns.

assessment: TELEPATHY: strongest against organic officers/support; much weaker vs robots
TELEKINESIS: positional control and light collision damage; anchored foes resist
TEST: obstacles, boss displacement and collisions must never cause soft-locks.
Glaz.revision: Illusions and Time Distortion removed. Telekinesis now includes physical impact and cover damage.

Needle.purpose: Remove an officer, elite or boss weak point efficiently.

a1.name: Focused Retina
a1.mechanic: See through light smoke; reduce partial-cover penalty for targeted shots.
a1.rule: Opaque walls still block line of sight.

a2.name: Retinal Lance
a2.mechanic: Precise beam against a visible marked enemy; ignore 1 intact armour this hit.
a2.rule: Does not destroy enemy armour; requires a clear straight firing line.

a4.name: X-Ray Angle
a4.mechanic: Shoot past one low-cover obstruction without its cover penalty.
a4.rule: No firing through solid walls or heavy obstructions.

a4.name: Fan Beam
a4.mechanic: Short-range, wide 3-tile cone deals 1 thermal damage to every unit hit.
a4.rule: Hits allies too; poor versus heavy armour; defensive anti-rush option.

a6.name: Prism Shot
a6.mechanic: Hit your marked target and an aligned foe directly behind it.
a6.rule: Secondary hit deals half damage; both require a clear beam path.

a8.name: Core Melter
a8.mechanic: Deal +3 direct damage to your mark along a clear firing line; ignore 2 armour.
a8.rule: Does not permanently break armour; no broad area damage.

origins.name: HAWK WINGS
origins.risk: Anti-air, tight interiors and landing exposure

a1.name: Wing Hop
a1.mechanic: Vault up to 3 tiles over low cover to a free landing cell.
a1.rule: No sustained flight; may still provoke ranged overwatch.

a2.name: Talon Descent
a2.mechanic: Dive from a clear approach onto your mark; land adjacent and deal +2 melee damage.
a2.rule: Needs free landing tile; use remaining 1 AP for Wing Hop if ready.

a4.name: Wing Buffet
a4.mechanic: Push a nearby light enemy 1 tile to open an escape lane.
a4.rule: Heavy or anchored targets resist the shove.

a4.name: Feather Guard
a4.mechanic: After landing from a dive, gain 1 temporary shield until your next phase.
a4.rule: Protects from one hit point, not area hazards or repeated heavy fire.

a6.name: Tethered Ascent
a6.mechanic: After a close-range attack, withdraw up to 3 tiles without that target's melee reaction.
a6.rule: Must land on a legal tile; other enemies' overwatch still applies.

a8.name: Raptor Descent
a8.mechanic: Dive onto your mark for +3 melee damage, then withdraw up to 2 clear tiles.
a8.rule: Withdrawal is part of the 3-AP attack; no extra AP or invulnerability.

1.name: Contract Mark
1.mechanic: Mark a visible priority enemy; one cover side treated as exposed on first hit.
1.rule: Mark lasts until target dies or replaced; resets at room end. No repeated fee.

3.name: Exploit Window
3.mechanic: Your first hit on the mark lets the next allied hit ignore 1 armour point.
3.rule: Works only on the same marked target.

5.name: Cold Precision
5.mechanic: If you have not moved, your next hit on mark ignores 1 extra armour.

5.name: Moving Execution
5.mechanic: After moving at least 2 tiles, your next hit on mark gains +1 damage.
5.rule: Rewards positional risk rather than stationary aiming.

7.name: Target Isolation
7.mechanic: Gain +1 damage against mark with no enemy allies in adjacent tiles.

9.name: Perfect Opportunity
9.mechanic: Prime your next marked attack this turn for +1 damage and bypass 1 intact armour.
9.rule: No free attack; marked-hit passive bonus damage capped at +2.

assessment: EYES: high single-target range and bypass; cone beam can hit allies
HAWK: setup → dive → 1-AP escape; vulnerable to landing and overwatch
TEST: mark stacking, 3-AP dive timing and counterfire against boss targets.
Needle.revision: Eye beams bypass, not permanently shred armour. Hawk gains planned extraction; wide cone risks friendly fire.

Iskra.purpose: Overcome enemy formations through suit engineering.

origins.name: DRONE COMMAND
origins.risk: EMP, destroyed drones and competing AP costs

a1.name: Controller Rig
a1.mechanic: Start each room with 1 small adjacent drone; it uses Iskra AP to act.
a1.rule: No independent turns; drone is an ability, not equipment.

a2.name: Remote Pulse
a2.mechanic: Move your drone up to 3 tiles; cancel one adjacent foe's overwatch.
a2.rule: Requires a living drone; blocks are still impassable.

a4.name: Interceptor Bot
a4.mechanic: Command drone to intercept the next targeted shot at an adjacent ally.
a4.rule: Drone takes the hit; AoE cannot be intercepted.

a4.name: Saboteur Bot
a4.mechanic: Drone disrupts one adjacent robot's reaction and movement for 1 phase.
a4.rule: Organic targets instead lose overwatch only.

a6.name: Remote Override
a6.mechanic: One robotic enemy loses reactions and 2 move tiles on its next phase.
a6.rule: Does not seize a whole enemy turn; basic enemies less vulnerable.

a8.name: Crossfire Protocol
a8.mechanic: Pilot and surviving drone attack the same target from two angles.
a8.rule: No bonus attack if drone is destroyed or out of line.

origins.name: ARTILLERY SUIT
origins.risk: Friendly fire, proximity and suit heat

a1.name: Micro-Rocket
a1.mechanic: Small blast damages one tile and adjacent targets, including allies.
a1.rule: Cannot target a tile next to yourself; damages light cover.

a2.name: Rocket Salvo
a2.mechanic: Explosive 3×3 blast against formations and destructible cover.
a2.rule: Allies in area are hit; ammunition integrated into suit.

a4.name: Cluster Burst
a4.mechanic: Wider blast deals reduced damage over several tiles.
a4.rule: Less effective versus heavily armoured single targets.

a4.name: Arc Net
a4.mechanic: Lay a 3-tile electrical hazard for 2 phases.
a4.rule: Water spreads risk; allies also suffer contact damage.

a6.name: Delayed Mortar
a6.mechanic: Mark a blast tile; ordnance lands at the next enemy-phase start.
a6.rule: Visible warning gives mobile enemies time to evade.

a8.name: Iron Rain
a8.mechanic: Mark three small zones; bombardment resolves at next enemy phase.
a8.rule: Friendly fire, telegraphed impact, overheating risk.

1.name: Power Routing
1.mechanic: Choose Mobility (+2 move this turn) or Overcharge (+1 blast damage or drone reach).
1.rule: Heat caps at 3; powered actions lock at Heat 3 until Vent. Basic actions remain.

3.name: Emergency Vent
3.mechanic: Spend 1 AP to remove 2 Heat and clear minor suit disruption.
3.rule: Basic attacks and movement always remain available.

5.name: Redline
5.mechanic: At Heat 2+, drone commands gain +1 reach OR artillery deals +1 damage; move -1 next phase.
5.rule: High damage but harder to reposition.

5.name: Cooling Circuit
5.mechanic: After moving 2+ tiles, lower Heat by 1 before your next suit action.
5.rule: Mobility trades off against stationary firing.

7.name: Rapid Recalibration
7.mechanic: After breaking cover, drone disruption or intercepting a shot, remove 1 Heat next phase.
7.rule: Requires a successful environmental or defensive play.

9.name: Emergency Overdrive
9.mechanic: Ignore Heat-3 ability lock for the rest of this turn.
9.rule: Must Vent next turn before advanced suit actions.

assessment: DRONE: flexible disruption, capped at one AP-bound device
ARTILLERY: AoE + hazards; punishing collateral risk
TEST: Heat 0–3, EMP and drone AI cannot cause soft-locks.
Iskra.revision: Juggernaut suit removed. Both remaining origins stay powered-armour based.

Alkhimik.purpose: Fill tactical gaps or protect the squad without erasing attrition.

origins.name: DARWINIAN
origins.risk: AP spent changing; none match full specialists

a1.name: Darwinian Shift
a1.mechanic: Frog: MOVE +1; Jellyfish: ARM CAP +1 and MOVE -1; Skunk: bio range +1.
a1.rule: One form at once; no armour restored by swapping. First form chosen at deployment.

a2.name: Adaptive Technique
a2.mechanic: Frog: 1-tile lunge + melee; Jellyfish: 1 barrier for self and adjacent ally; Skunk: range-3 musk cancels organic reactions.
a2.rule: Skunk affects organic foes only; Jellyfish barrier is temporary; no free AP.

a4.name: Stable Adaptation
a4.mechanic: Frog: first lunge +1 DMG; Jellyfish: Gel Guard gives self +1 barrier; Skunk: spray +1 range.
a4.rule: Benefits current form only; not specialist-level damage or defence.

a4.name: Rapid Metamorph
a4.mechanic: Change form and step up to 2 clear tiles without adjacent melee reactions.
a4.rule: Counts as your one form change this turn; normal ranged overwatch applies.

a6.name: Gene Transfer
a6.mechanic: Give one ally a lesser adaptation: Frog +1 MOVE; Jellyfish +1 barrier; Skunk +1 attack range.
a6.rule: One ally at a time; cannot share form attacks or repair armour.

a8.name: Apex Reconfiguration
a8.mechanic: Frog MOVE +2 and first hit DMG +1; Jellyfish BARRIER 2 plus one intercept; Skunk: 3-tile musk zone.
a8.rule: Locks current form for 2 phases; interception protects one adjacent ally. No healing.

origins.name: HEALING
origins.risk: 4 treatment charges for all linked rooms; zero revives

a1.name: Cell Mender
a1.mechanic: Heal one ally for 2 HP; consume 1 of 4 treatment charges in entire mission.
a1.rule: Charges do not reset between rooms; cannot exceed downed 50% HP cap.

a2.name: Protective Clot
a2.mechanic: Give one ally a 1-point temporary barrier until its next phase.
a2.rule: Costs no treatment charges; prevents damage, does not restore HP.

a4.name: Communal Clot
a4.mechanic: Heal up to 3 allies in a small zone by 1 HP each; costs 2 treatments.
a4.rule: Unspent charges required; no revival or status reset.

a4.name: Scar Weave
a4.mechanic: Give one ally a 1-point temporary barrier and remove one minor biological debuff.
a4.rule: No HP restored; cannot remove permanent injuries or downing ceiling.

a6.name: Crisis Mending
a6.mechanic: Restore 3 HP to a wounded ally below half its normal HP.
a6.rule: Counts against 4 mission charges and never revives an incapacitated ally.

a8.name: Regenerative Wave
a8.mechanic: Heal up to 3 allies within 3 tiles for 1 HP each; give each 1 temporary shield.
a8.rule: Once per mission, costs 2 treatment charges; downing and injury limits remain.

1.name: Adaptive Catalyst
1.mechanic: Prime self or one ally within 3 tiles: choose +1 movement this turn or 1 temporary barrier.
1.rule: No healing; barrier expires next phase; cannot repair armour.

3.name: Metabolic Reserve
3.mechanic: After your first biological skill each round, gain +1 movement this turn.
3.rule: Movement is not a free attack or extra AP.

5.name: Controlled Change
5.mechanic: After applying a biological skill, step 1 legal tile without adjacent melee reaction.
5.rule: Does not avoid ranged overwatch or gain AP.

5.name: Potent Formula
5.mechanic: First supportive biological skill each round grants 1 extra temporary shield.
5.rule: Does not increase HP healing or replenish treatment charges.

7.name: Condition Control
7.mechanic: First supportive biological skill on yourself or ally each round removes one minor debuff.
7.rule: No permanent injury treatment, armour repair or early recovery.

9.name: Catalytic Cascade
9.mechanic: Prime next non-healing buff or transfer to also reach a second ally at half strength.
9.rule: Never duplicates HP healing, capstones, or treatment charges.

assessment: DARWINIAN: Frog attacks, Jellyfish protects, Skunk disrupts; all below specialists
HEALING: 4 total charges across rooms; shields/cleanse remain repeatable
TEST: no healing farm between rooms; post-down cap and permadeath preserved.
Alkhimik.revision: Frog/Jellyfish/Skunk are styles for switchable forms. Healing uses 4 mission-wide charges; no free HP heals.
